# task-16e09356 — Frame interiors receive checkerboard marker color

## Reusable rule from demos and solved test
The grid contains several hollow rectangular frames outlined in different colors and sparse isolated marker cells outside them. Each hollow frame is filled inside with an alternating checkerboard pattern whose color is the marker color associated with that frame; the frame outline and all unrelated/background areas remain as in the input (typically 0 outside).

For each frame independently:
1. Identify its complete rectangular outline and determine its inclusive bounding box (top, bottom, left, right).
2. Find isolated single-cell markers elsewhere in the grid. Each frame has its own marker color, which is signaled by those external markers (in the examples each frame has its own distinct marker color).
3. Fill only strictly interior cells, alternating marker-color and background in checkerboard fashion. Across all cases, the top-left interior cell is the marker color, then alternate by local interior row+column parity: marker iff `(r-(top+1) + c-(left+1)) % 2 == 0`. Do not overwrite the frame outline.
4. Ignore other isolated clutter/colors unrelated to the frame-marker mapping; remove/leave external markers according to the observed transformation: demos show all external isolated markers disappear, so output background there.

## Demonstration evidence
Demo 1: 18x23. Frame color 8 at rows 1–4, cols 1–7 was filled in its 2x5 interior with checkerboard color 3, top-left interior cell colored. Frame color 4 at rows 6–13, cols 14–20 was filled with checkerboard color 6 in its 6x5 interior, top-left interior cell colored. # task-16e09356 — Frame interiors receive checkerboard marker color

## Reusable rule from demos and solved test
The grid contains hollow rectangular frames outlined in different colors and sparse isolated marker cells outside them. Each frame is filled inside with an alternating checkerboard pattern whose color is the marker color associated with that frame; frame outlines remain unchanged and unrelated/background areas become/remain 0.

For each frame independently:
1. Identify its complete rectangular outline and inclusive bounding box (top, bottom, left, right).
2. Determine the associated marker color from the isolated single-cell markers outside it. In examples each frame has its own distinct marker color.
3. Fill only strictly interior cells, alternating marker-color and background in checkerboard fashion. The top-left interior cell is always marker color; marker iff `(r-(top+1) + c-(left+1)) % 2 == 0`. Do not overwrite the frame outline.
4. Remove all external isolated markers/clutter to background 0; demos show every non-frame cell outside the rectangles is 0 in output.

## Demonstration evidence
Demo 1 (18x23): Frame color 8 at rows 1–4, cols 1–7 was filled in its 2x5 interior with checkerboard color 3, top-left interior colored. Frame color 4 at rows 6–13, cols 14–20 was filled with checkerboard color 6 in its 6x5 interior, top-left interior colored. All original isolated 6 and 3 marker cells outside frames disappeared to 0.

Demo 2 (20x20): Frame color 2 at rows 1–5, cols 2–6 got checkerboard color 8 in its 3x3 interior, top-left interior colored. Frame color 3 at rows 10–13, cols 9–17 got checkerboard color 4 in its 2x7 interior, top-left interior colored. External markers of colors 8 and 4 disappeared; all else remained 0.

Solved test (22x26): Frame color 1 bbox r1–6,c3–11 received checkerboard 4; frame color 2 bbox r10–13,c2–5 received checkerboard 8; frame color 3 bbox r9–16,c11–21 received checkerboard 5. All interiors started with marker color at top-left (even local parity). External sparse markers were removed. This output was correct after one incorrect attempt.

## Failed attempt / pitfalls
First submission filled checkerboard with wrong parity/origin and retained outside clutter. Correct orientation is anchored to top-left interior cell, not global grid parity. Start at (top+1,left+1) with marker color, alternate horizontally and vertically. Remove isolated outside markers rather than preserve them. Keep frame borders unchanged.

## Validation checklist
- Keep each outline exactly unchanged.
- Confirm checkerboard dimensions are `(height-2) x (width-2)`.
- Marker color is at interior top-left; other cells follow local parity.
- All non-frame cells outside the interiors are 0.
- Preserve output dimensions.
